headline: score
goal: Raise mean per-duel score on the Duels III format (arena session 3: price+days, 12 ticks, decay 0.10, 4 concurrent, paired limit hidden) via a duel.py --params file only. Guardrails: limit_breach stays 0; duels-friday and duels-saturday (real rival paths) not worse than baseline by more than 0.01 mean score.
split_note: TRAIN = arena seeds 0.. (duel_tune's tuning set; the only traces read to form hypotheses). SELECTION = seeds 500000.. (duel_tune / duel_ab held-out gate). TEST = this eval: 100 sessions from seed 900000 (6,800 duels), never read as traces, only summary numbers; keep a round only if the paired per-session score diff vs the previous best is > 2 SE above 0. duel_tune's stress uses 800000..800079, disjoint. duels-friday / duels-saturday are guardrails only. Split fixed 2026-10-03 21:35.
climb_result: 2026-10-03: v1 kept (last_chance_ticks 2, +0.0035 +- 0.0025 on TEST); v2-v4 reverted. Kept as evals/duels-arena/duel-params-duels3-v1-old-referee.json (pre-#47/#54 referee; superseded by WP1's docs/duel-lab/duel-params-duels3.json).
